feature: Commitment contract authoritative data mapping and draft-stage Owner fallback

flows.name: Render a commitment contract from current records
steps: Load the project canonical job number, Client, and address
Load the commitment Contract Company, SOV total, and retainage
Resolve Contractor from the linked prime contractor when present or the canonical Alleato identity when absent
Render a blank legal Owner line when the project Client is not yet selected
Reject generation when a required Subcontractor, financial value, or template marker is missing
flows.expectedOutcome: The rendered contract contains only current project and commitment values, works before a prime contract or Client exists, leaves an unset Owner visibly blank, and fails before PDF generation only when required commitment inputs are missing

checks: Correct amount and canonical job number are visible
The project address is not duplicated
Only the current subcontractor notice block is present
An unset Owner is a blank underline and never the text Not set

claims.description: Current amount, retainage, canonical job number, and normalized address replace all legacy sample values

Owner resolves exclusively from the project Client when present and otherwise renders blank; Subcontractor comes from the commitment Contract Company; Contractor remains complete without a prime contract
Missing required Subcontractor, financial inputs, or template markers stop generation with actionable errors while a missing draft-stage Owner remains downloadable
